mentions.speaker: Cred
mentions.context: Monthly time frame at range midpoint acting as resistance, failed breakout pattern
mentions.quote: This is still looking like a monthly time frame bearish retest at the moment. The bullish idea was contingent on a monthly time frame acceptance through the range midpoint into the range high... neither has taken place.

key_insights: BTC is at monthly range midpoint resistance ($44.47k) after failing to break through
Monthly levels remain relevant - range low at 35-37k is the next target
Failed breakout pattern suggests continuation downward until support is reached
A second failed breakout at 44-46k is less likely, so reclaim would be bullish
summary: Cred provides a bearish technical analysis of BTC, noting it's at monthly range midpoint resistance ($44.47k) after a failed breakout attempt. The market has rejected key levels and moving averages, making a bearish retest likely until proven otherwise. He expects price to target monthly support at 35-37k, with 40k as a possible interim bounce area. Trading back above 44k would be bullish as a second failed breakout is less likely.
